Definition: fall, i.e. decadence; concretely, a ruin; specifically a carcase
BiblicalUsage: mappeleth is a fall, a ruin, and sometimes a carcase. In Ezekiel 27:27 Tyre's riches and mariners fall into the midst of the seas in the day of her ruin, and in Ezekiel 31:16 the nations shake at the sound of Assyria's fall. In Judges 14:8 Samson turns aside to see the carcase of the lion, and in Proverbs 29:16 the righteous shall see the fall of the wicked. The word is the crash after the pride.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mappeleth teaches me that every fall has a sound, and the righteous will see it. I hold that the fall of the proud is God's doing, not man's revenge, and I will leave the crashing to Him.
